scope: Local macOS arm64 allocation-byte diagnostics only; no elapsed-time or controlled performance acceptance claim.

manifest.purpose: Allocation diagnosis only; no CPU or throughput claim

limitations: TotalAlloc is bytes requested, not retained memory, allocation count or CPU time.
Standalone context modes and VM operations have different contracts; no arithmetic attribution is claimed.
Session closure setup is counted once, full public operation setup is counted per call.
These are local allocation diagnostics, not controlled performance acceptance.

summary.classification: Standalone allocation-byte diagnostic only; same field layout as the 64-byte opaque Extern, no wasmvm or throughput claim. Not a compiler defect without independent lowering evidence.

staticAssembly.limitations: Static direct call sites include branch-dependent paths and callees may allocate; these are not allocation event counts or CPU shares.
